main.description: What someone does to hold their world together, on the Atlas of Care: one sentence in their own words that begins with "I". It lives in the repo of whoever says it, so nobody writes one about someone else. It may name a place, as an administrative unit picked from a list, never an address.

atlas.description: The atlas this statement is for. The backlink index finds statements by this field.

text.description: One line that begins with "I". No web address and no @-mention in it.

url.description: Optional. A web address for the thing they do.

scope.description: Optional, with unit. Which of the atlas's lists of places the unit is on.

unit.description: Optional, with scope. The unit's id on that list.
